message: With storm season upon us, I’ve been reminiscing about the good old days when we’d huddle together during thunderstorms with a deck of cards and some flashlights. It’s amazing how a little weather can inspire us to put down our devices and rediscover some low-tech fun. If you’re looking for tips on how to stay safe and make the most of a stormy day, there’s a great resource out there to help. Just remember, a little rain never hurt anyone—unless you forget your umbrella! ☔️
